title: calibrachoa parviflora
intro: Calibrachoa parviflora, commonly known as the Mini Petunia, is a perennial plant species in the evening primrose family, known for its vibrant and delicate flowers. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Calibrachoa parviflora are attributed to its ability to exert anxiolytic, sedative, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Calibrachoa parviflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
